ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS AGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), is made as of the  day of )E ′t :/, 2004, by 10-12 COOPER SQUARE, INC., a New York corporation having its principal office c/o Solil Management, 640 Fifth Avenue, 3rd floor, New York, New York, 10019 ("Owner” and “Developer"). WITNESSEIH: WHEREAS,the Owneris the ownerinfee simple of certain land located in the Borough of Manhattan, Owner, County and State of New York, known as and by the street address 35 East 4th Street, New York,New York and being Lot 68 of Block 544 as shown on the Tax Map of The City of New York and being more particularly described in Exhibit A-1 attached hereto (the “Lot 68 Property"); WHEREAS, the Owner is also the owner in fee simple of certain land and the improvements thereon located in the Borough of Manhattan, Owner, County and State ofNewYork,known as Lots 59,65,66 and 67of Block 544 as shown on the Tax Mapof The City of NewYork and beingmoreparticularly described inExhibit A-2 attached hereto(the“Development Property"); WHEREAS,the Owner intends to develop,either directly or through a lease or other conveyance of an interest in the Development Property to a party as may be designated by the Owner (either Owner or such party as may be designated by Owner is hereinafter referred to as“Developer")for the purpose of having Developer construct on the Development Property a New Building (as hereinafter defined); WHEREAS, the Developer intends, to the extent permitted by law and pursuant to the terms of this Agreement, to construct on the Development Property the New Building, which is expected to contain more Floor Area, as such term is defined in theZoningResolutionof TheCityof NewYork,effectiveDecember15,1961(as amended from time to time, the “Zoning Resolution"), than is presently available for use on the Development Property under the Zoning Resolution; WHEREAS, (i) the term“Floor Area Development Rights” shall mean the development rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop the zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total Floor Area determined (A) by multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the maximum allowable floor area ratio for structures in the zoning district or districts in which such zoning lot is located, (B) by the inclusion of any available “bonus" floor area, and (C) by the further inclusion of any use, bulk, density and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution and which may be authorized to be developed by the appropriate agency of The City of New York from time to time; (i) the term“Excess Development Rights”shall mean the total of all of the Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant to the Lot 68 Property on the date hereof; and meanings set forth in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution;
